metadata.case_name: KWAN WING LEUNG v. FUNG CHI LEUNG AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: plaintiff suffered soft tissue injury of the neck from a sprain injury in the accident.
source: In the joint medical report, both experts agreed that the plaintiff suffered soft tissue injury of the neck from a sprain injury in the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

manifestations.description: Persistent pain on neck and upper back
Range of rotation of neck limited by pain
Right hand carrying capacity limited to 3 pounds
Psychological effects such as anxiety over future career problems
The prospect of a vigorous, contended and happy life has been seriously diminished after the accident.
pain in the neck radiated down to his right arm

treatments_received: Attendance at Pok Oi Hospital and transfer to Department of Orthopaedic & Traumatology of Tuen Mun Hospital
Physiotherapy (10 sessions in Pok Oi Hospital between 11.10.2010 and 13.12.2010)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities of life including persistent neck and upper back pain, persistent right arm pain, limited neck rotation, reduced sitting tolerance, limited right hand carrying capacity and psychological effects (anxiety, diminished prospect of a vigorous life).
